decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the raised mixer base as a custom-fabrication exception.
Platform height and serving-cup clearance do not change the whisk configuration or its operating criteria.
The raised platform and external cup clearance do not alter bowl removal, swapping, or internal assembly clearance.

The newly accepted base requires additional fabrication materials, but it is unclear whether those materials must revise the purchasing BOM or invalidate the existing statement that no additional components are needed at this stage.
The source specifies platform dimensions and fit but does not change the already established platform or machine colors.
Providing clearance beneath the spouts for 12-ounce cups does not change the mixing splash-control requirement.
The platform dimensions and edge-to-edge machine fit do not change the branding text, placard placement, or placard sides.
The 12-ounce vessels referenced by the source are serving cups beneath the spouts, not the matcha mixing bowls.
The dimensional platform decision does not alter the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The platform creates clearance beneath the existing spouts without changing their geometry, orientation, construction, or beverage-quality constraints.
The finalized system layout must incorporate the newly specified platform height, serving-cup clearance, and edge-to-edge machine footprint.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: This is the idea. I want the base to be five and a half inches tall so that our 12oz cups fit under the spouts. I want the machine to fit and sit on top of it perfectly. Edge to edge.

value_updates.raised_platform_layout_specification: Include a 5.5-inch-tall base that provides clearance for 12-ounce cups beneath the spouts and supports a perfect edge-to-edge machine fit.

decisions.reason: The external platform and serving-cup clearance do not change the required matcha texture, foam consistency, or mixing behavior.
